verdict.rationale: Yapily documents a first-party sandbox: a test environment where an application connects to a bank and uses test accounts to simulate the real Open Banking experience. That covers testing without touching production data. Only one overview-level doc supports it. Missing for 10: details on how sandbox credentials and environment are separated from production, which sandbox institutions or flows are covered (AIS/PIS, webhooks), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: A sandbox is a test environment that allows you to connect your application to a bank and access test accounts to simulate the real Open Banking experience.
